course_description: Foundational study of intelligent agents, problem solving via heuristic search (A*, Minimax), knowledge representation, supervised learning, neural network architectures, PyTorch implementation, and computer vision with convolutional neural networks.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement classical search algorithms including BFS, DFS, A* heuristic search, and Minimax game playing.
Analyze supervised regression and classification models using gradient descent optimization.
Construct multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural networks using PyTorch for pattern recognition.
Evaluate convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures on visual classification tasks.
Design an intelligent agent solving real-world automated reasoning or computer vision problems.

weekly_schedule.topic: Introduction to AI, Turing Test, Rational Agents, and PEAS Descriptions
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Agent Design Workshop and Python Setup

lesson_outcomes.description: Define intelligence paradigms and rational agent classifications
Construct PEAS (Performance, Environment, Actuators, Sensors) models
Acknowledge the ethical considerations of autonomous agents

weekly_schedule.topic: Uninformed Search Strategies: Breadth-First, Depth-First, and Uniform-Cost

lesson_outcomes.description: Formulate state space graphs and search frontier mechanics
Implement BFS and DFS maze traversal algorithms in Python
Value algorithmic completeness versus memory space trade-offs

weekly_schedule.topic: Informed (Heuristic) Search: Greedy Best-First Search and A* Algorithm

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain admissible and consistent heuristic properties
Code the A* algorithm using priority queues and Manhattan distance
Strive for optimal pathfinding performance

weekly_schedule.topic: Adversarial Search: Game Playing, Minimax Algorithm, and Alpha-Beta Pruning

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe game trees, utility functions, and zero-sum game dynamics
Implement Minimax decision trees with Alpha-Beta pruning
Display patience and rigor in debugging recursive game states

weekly_schedule.topic: Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSP): Backtracking and Forward Checking

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain variables, domains, constraints, and arc consistency
Write constraint satisfaction backtracking solvers
Appreciate pruning efficiency in combinatorial spaces

weekly_schedule.topic: Preliminary Examination: Problem Formulation and Search Algorithms Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Recall search theorems, heuristic equations, and complexity proofs
Execute live timed search algorithm implementations
Demonstrate integrity and professionalism under exam conditions

weekly_schedule.topic: Knowledge Representation: Propositional and First-Order Logic Inference

lesson_outcomes.description: Formulate logical propositions, truth tables, and Horn clauses
Build simple rule-based inference engines and forward chaining
Value structured deductive reasoning in AI knowledge systems

weekly_schedule.topic: Supervised Learning: Linear Regression, Cost Functions, and Gradient Descent

lesson_outcomes.description: Derive Mean Squared Error (MSE) and partial derivative update rules
Code vector-based batch gradient descent in Python and NumPy
Appreciate mathematical elegance in objective function minimization

weekly_schedule.topic: Logistic Regression and Binary Cross-Entropy Loss for Classification

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain sigmoid activation, odds ratios, and log-loss mechanics
Implement logistic regression decision boundaries
Commit to thorough verification of false positive rates

weekly_schedule.topic: Optimization Algorithms: Stochastic Gradient Descent, Adam, and Learning Rates

lesson_outcomes.description: Contrast batch gradient descent with Adam adaptive momentum
Tune learning rate hyperparameters to avoid local minima traps
Exhibit perseverance when troubleshooting non-converging loss

weekly_schedule.topic: Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP): Forward Propagation and Backpropagation

lesson_outcomes.description: Formulate backpropagation chain rules for gradient calculation
Construct basic multi-layer perceptrons with ReLU activations
Value mathematical depth in artificial neural computation

weekly_schedule.topic: Midterm Examination: Optimization and Neural Network Theory Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize gradient descent derivations and logical inference
Execute timed neural network training and validation tasks
Demonstrate mastery under timed evaluation

weekly_schedule.topic: PyTorch Framework Foundations: Tensors, Autograd, and DataLoader Modules

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain automatic differentiation and computational graph construction
Build modular PyTorch training, validation, and testing loops
Value modular engineering when structuring deep learning code

weekly_schedule.topic: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN): Convolutions, Pooling, and Strides

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe feature map extraction, kernel weights, and max-pooling
Implement convolutional filter passes on image tensors
Display curiosity in computer vision spatial representations

weekly_schedule.topic: CNN Architectures for Image Classification (LeNet, AlexNet, ResNet)

lesson_outcomes.description: Analyze vanishing gradients and residual shortcut connections
Fine-tune pretrained ResNet backbones using transfer learning
Uphold scientific rigor when reporting classification metrics

weekly_schedule.topic: Introduction to Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Recurrent Architectures

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain word tokenization, vocabulary building, and embedding vectors
Train text classification models using LSTM or simple Transformers
Value linguistic nuances and context in language AI

weekly_schedule.topic: AI Project Integration, Model Explainability, and Ethical Guidelines

lesson_outcomes.description: Evaluate algorithmic bias, fairness, and model interpretability
Package intelligent AI models into accessible web applications
Practice constructive teamwork and peer code review

weekly_schedule.topic: Final Examination & Capstone Defense: Intelligent Agent Project Presentation

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize classical search, machine learning, and deep neural networks
Defend a fully functional AI application before a faculty panel
Demonstrate Perpetualite leadership, communication, and ethical virtue
